name: equipment_usage_and_maintenance
description: Sets eligibility, permitted use, checkout, safety, maintenance, reporting, and duration requirements for company equipment.

variables.name: employee_type
variables.description: Employment category of the person requesting equipment use.

variables.name: equipment_type
variables.description: Type of company equipment being used; machinery use triggers the safety-gear requirement.

variables.name: use_purpose
variables.description: Whether the equipment is being used for official business or personal purposes.

variables.name: consecutive_use_hours
variables.description: Number of consecutive hours the equipment will be used.

variables.name: has_operations_manager_prior_authorization
variables.description: Whether a contractor received prior authorization from the Operations Manager.

variables.name: has_explicit_approval
variables.description: Whether an intern or part-time employee was explicitly granted approval to use equipment.

variables.name: is_logged_out_in_operations_portal
variables.description: Whether the equipment was logged out through the Operations Portal before use.

variables.name: safety_check_completed_before_use
variables.description: Whether the equipment underwent a safety check before this use.

variables.name: fault_or_damage_exists
variables.description: Whether any fault or damage exists on the equipment.

variables.name: hours_since_fault_or_damage_identified
variables.description: Hours elapsed since the fault or damage was identified.

variables.name: fault_or_damage_reported_to_operations
variables.description: Whether the fault or damage was reported to the Operations Department.

variables.name: repair_performed
variables.description: Whether repair or maintenance work was performed on the equipment.

variables.name: repair_performed_by_operations_approved_vendor
variables.description: Whether the repair or maintenance was performed by a vendor approved by Operations.

variables.name: has_manager_approval_for_extended_use
variables.description: Whether a manager approved use exceeding 8 consecutive hours.

variables.name: is_overnight_use
variables.description: Whether the equipment use will continue overnight.

variables.name: has_written_operations_manager_overnight_approval
variables.description: Whether written approval for overnight use was provided by the Operations Manager.

variables.name: required_safety_gear_worn
variables.description: Whether the required safety gear, such as helmets or gloves, is worn when using company machinery.

variables.name: safety_rules_compliant
variables.description: Whether the user complies with applicable safety rules during equipment use.

rules.description: Full-time employees qualify to use company equipment, subject to the policy's other requirements.
Contractors qualify to use company equipment when they have prior Operations Manager authorization.
Interns qualify to use company equipment when explicitly granted approval.
Part-time employees qualify to use company equipment when explicitly granted approval.
Contractor equipment use without prior Operations Manager authorization is prohibited.
Intern equipment use without explicit approval is prohibited.
Part-time employee equipment use without explicit approval is prohibited.
Company equipment must not be used for personal purposes.
Equipment use without first logging it out through the Operations Portal is prohibited.
Equipment use without a safety check before use is prohibited.
A fault or damage must be reported to the Operations Department within 24 hours of identification.
rules.condition: fault_or_damage_exists == true AND hours_since_fault_or_damage_identified > 24 AND fault_or_damage_reported_to_operations != true

rules.description: Repairs or maintenance performed by a vendor not approved by Operations are prohibited.
Use exceeding 8 consecutive hours requires manager approval.
Overnight equipment use requires written approval from the Operations Manager.
Required safety gear must be worn when using company machinery.
Failure to comply with applicable safety rules results in suspension of equipment access and makes the use noncompliant.

examples.question: Can a full-time employee use a company laptop for official business for 4 hours after logging it out and completing a safety check?
examples.explanation: The full-time employee has a standalone eligibility basis, the use is for official business, and the stated checkout and safety requirements are met.

examples.question: Can a contractor use company machinery for official business without prior Operations Manager authorization?
examples.explanation: Contractors require prior authorization from the Operations Manager.

examples.question: Can an approved intern use equipment for personal purposes?
examples.explanation: Explicit approval does not permit personal use of company equipment.

examples.question: Can a full-time employee use a vehicle for 10 consecutive hours without manager approval?
examples.explanation: Use exceeding 8 consecutive hours requires manager approval.
